lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Agar aur jeete rehte, yahi intezaar hota
couplets.en: Had I lived longer, I would still have been waiting.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Tere vaade par jiye hum to ye jaan jhooth jaana
couplets.en: If I say your promise kept me alive, know that I lie.

lines: Ki khushi se mar na jaate agar e'tibaar hota
couplets.en: Had I believed you, I would have died of joy.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Koi mere dil se poochhe tere teer-e-neem-kash ko
couplets.en: Ask my heart what it knows of the arrow you drew only halfway.

lines: Ye khalish kahaan se hoti jo jigar ke paar hota
couplets.en: Would it still sting if the arrow had gone clean through?

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Rag-e-sang se tapakta vo lahu ki phir na thamta
couplets.en: Blood would seep from the veins of stone and never stop.

lines: Jise gham samajh rahe ho, ye agar sharaar hota
couplets.en: If only what you call grief were a spark.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Kahoon kis se main ki kya hai, shab-e-gham buri bala hai
couplets.en: Who can I tell how cruel a night of grief can be?

lines: Mujhe kya bura tha marna agar ek baar hota
couplets.en: I would hardly mind dying if it happened only once.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Hue mar ke hum jo rusva, hue kyoon na gharq-e-dariya
couplets.en: If death was to disgrace me, why did I not drown in the river?

lines: Na kabhi janaaza uthta, na kaheen mazaar hota
couplets.en: No one would have borne my bier, and nowhere would there be a grave.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Use kaun dekh sakta ki yagaana hai vo yakta
couplets.en: Who could see Him, the One who has no equal?

lines: Jo du'i ki boo bhi hoti to kaheen do-chaar hota
couplets.en: Were there even a trace of duality, we might meet Him somewhere.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ki visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Ye masaa'il-e-tasavvuf, ye tera bayaan, Ghalib
couplets.en: Such mysteries of the spirit, Ghalib, and such a way with words.

lines: Tujhe hum vali samajhte jo na baada-khvaar hota
couplets.en: We might take you for a saint were it not for the wine.
